name: Forge
description: A bold, dark, award-style marketing site for a creative / brand & web studio — a warm near-black canvas with an acid-green accent, a recreated case-study showcase, a scrolling client + awards marquee, a 2-up work gallery, a 4-up stat band, numbered services, a process timeline, and testimonials, plus Work, Services, About, Insights, Careers, a Contact form, three seeded insight articles with a blog index, and brand-voiced welcome + studio-notes emails. Near-monochrome dark apex theme with a single acid accent. Installs as a draft for the tenant to review, customize, and publish.
